_comment: Copy to a PRODUCT repo root as `.owner-dispatch.json` and commit it to opt that repo into the owner-dispatch firing gate. Absent or enabled:false => the gate is a complete no-op. ccl-skills itself is NOT a product repo and intentionally ships no such file (its own edits are shared-skill/process edits, exempt from owner-load).
owner_hint: product-rd-workflow, then the touched stack owner (*-dev / *-architecture / testing-strategy / product-ui-ux-design)
